name: typescript
description: TypeScript: a type-check hook after each edit, vitest/jest test discipline, mock-fidelity lens, type-ripple and request/response type checks.

facts.name: TS_PACKAGE_DIRS
facts.meaning: Dirs (from the repo root, comma-separated; `.` is the root) whose own tsc the edit hook runs. `auto` means every dir holding a tsconfig.json, up to depth 2.
facts.ask: Which directories hold a TypeScript package the after-edit type check should cover? Comma-separated paths from the repo root, or `auto` to use every directory with a tsconfig.json (up to two levels deep).

facts.name: TEST_FRAMEWORK
facts.meaning: The TypeScript test runner: vitest, jest, or none when the project has no runner yet.
facts.ask: Which test runner do the TypeScript packages use: vitest, jest, or none (no runner yet)?

owner_tasks.task: If TEST_FRAMEWORK is none: add a test runner (vitest or jest), add its command to TEST_COMMANDS, and set TEST_FRAMEWORK with an installer upgrade
owner_tasks.why: until then, contract tests are plain node:test scripts, and a row they can't drive is BLOCKED
